text:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT detected — text-generation.api.high-latency on us-east-1 (p95 spiking). Paging oncall.
Alex M: picking up the page, looking. any immediate customer-facing failures?
Priya S: some downstream retries, a couple of 504s reported from storefront, but not a full outage. severity feel like P1 unless it gets worse.
Samir K: I see elevated RTs in the serving runtime. KV cache eviction spikes at the same time. throwing extra GC on host gpu-03.
Maria P: tagging @Alex M and @Samir K — could be the new batching config from last deploy?
Alex M: rolling back last batch-config change on canary now. will report.
OpsBot: deploy rollback triggered by @Alex M: rollback-id=rb-2026-04-15-21. ETA ~90s.
Alex M: canaries show latency dropping on canary shards. staging looks good. rolling global rollback.
Oncall Bot: PAGE update — mitigation in progress, rollback initiated.
Evan R: FYI support ticket #38421 — customer reported slow completions for embeddings churn. linking here for impact assessment: https://support.internal/38421
Priya S: current estimate: ~12k requests affected in 30m window. customer visible errors ~120. recommend P1 with post-incident review.
Samir K: root cause hypothesis: batching heuristic change + increased prefix length distribution causing KV pressure and small-batch stalls. watching memory and kv miss rate.
Maria P: logs snippet from gpu-03 around spike:
```
[2026-04-15T21:12:03Z] kv_cache_evictions=1245, kv_miss_rate=0.42, batch_wait_ms=45
[2026-04-15T21:12:03Z] runtime_latency_p95=720ms, runtime_latency_p99=1.45s
```
Priya S: holding handoff — Alex, if you need to pass to next oncall please mention immediate remediation steps and pain.
Alex M: Handoff in 20m to @Samir K (oncall+followup). Current status: rollback complete, latencies back to baseline on all regions, monitoring dashboards green. Remaining: collect logs, correlation with canary deploy, quick customer outreach draft.
Samir K: ack taking post-mitigations and root-cause verification. I will run targeted kv cache pressure tests and reproduce the spike with batch config locally.
Oncall Bot: Mitigation closed — page cleared. Please schedule postmortem within 72 hours if impact >100 errors or cross-customer.
Priya S: scheduling postmortem: propose 2026-04-18 16:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation plan, action items + owners + sizing.
Maria P: adding link to runbook and incident timeline doc: https://confluence.internal/incidents/1998765432-timeline (draft)
Alex M: action items I want in the post-incident:
- A1: Revert-safe batching rollout procedure (owner: Alex M) — estimate 3 days.
- A2: Add KV cache pressure alert with automated throttling (owner: Samir K) — estimate 2 days.
- A3: Customer outreach + credit review for affected accounts (owner: Priya S) — estimate 1 day.
- A4: Add regression test to evals for prefix-length distributions (owner: Maria P) — estimate 4 days.
- A5: Add canary monitoring for batching latency delta (owner: Evan R) — estimate 2 days.
Priya S: let's size by severity bucket and Q-plan tie-in:
- Sev1/P0 items: A1 and A2 (must land this sprint).
- P1 items: A4 and A5 (next sprint/QA).
- Customer outreach: operational, do asap but low engineering time.
Alex M: agree. For planning: tag A1/A2 to "Q2 reliability sprint" and break into sub-tasks: rollback automation (1d), canary gating (2d), docs & runbook updates (4h).
Samir K: I will create the GH issues and add estimates + labels (sev:P0, sprint:Q2-rel) — assign owners.
Evan R: small observability tweak: dashboard panels for batch_size distribution and kv_miss_rate. 4h to implement. add to A5.
Priya S: action item tracker — please include the following metadata on each issue: owner, estimate (days), priority (P0/P1), sprint tag, customer impact note. We'll use that for postmortem scoring.
Alex M: will post initial postmortem draft after SAMIR reproduces locally.
Maria P: pinging support to prepare outreach copy for affected customers, note incidents channel for transparency.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: run follow-up checks 24 hours after rollback to ensure no regression.
Samir K: quick note on mitigations: we added a temporary throttle in the serving layer to limit batch accumulation at 250ms. Need to replace with smarter dynamic heuristic. Add as A6 (owner: Samir K, estimate: 3 days, priority: P0).
Priya S: re-prioritizing — include A6 with A1/A2 as P0.
Alex M: final checklist for postmortem meeting: timeline, root cause proof (repro logs), action item list with owners/estimates, customer impact summary, Q2 sprint mapping.
Evan R: I'll put calendar invite and link to docs.
Priya S: thanks all. closing thread once postmortem invite is accepted and GH issues created. reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:.
